item.tib: gshen bstan rtag 'bar smon lam rnam par rgyal ba'i tshangs dbyangs
item.coloph: de ltar gnas kyi sgo nas smon lam rnam par dag par gsol ba phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshangs dbyangs zhes bya 'di ni ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gling ming bcu gnyis la smon lam rnam pa dag pa gdab/ ces lung du mar mnos pa zhang zhung sgo yi tha ma sum pa glang gi gyim shod rang gi blo la dang / dang*/ ma zad grub rigs dam pa 'ga' yi nan tan du bskul ba la brten nas/ kyi mthil du 'khod pa brag dmar ri 'dus kyi zhol 'bum pa sum pa mu spungs gsal stong gi sprul pa spyang btsun tshe dbang bstan rgyal gyi tshogs (gyis phyag) btab pa'i 'dus sde chen po g.yung drung bstan pa rab rgyas gling du rgyal kham pa mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa 'am/ g.yung drung bdud 'dul thogs med rtsal zhes kyi lo zla srin po zhes pa shing mo yos bu lor/ hor zla dang po'i tshes bzang por gsol ba gdab pas/ de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig bkra shis dpal 'bar bon bstan dar rgyas shog/
